entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: The newly elected khan of the Abzan Houses, a former general of the Abzan army whose family was killed in a Sultai ambush that her cousin Oret arranged.

entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: A krumar orc, born Mardu and raised by Anafenza's family, who survives the ambush with her and becomes her sworn brother.

entities.name: Oret
entities.description: Anafenza's cousin and house cartographer, who secretly hired the Sultai to destroy their house and is disowned by her as khan.

entities.name: Hakrez
entities.description: The whispering kin-tree warden of Anafenza's house and its most skilled warrior, who teaches Anafenza about kin and dies in the ambush.

entities.name: Kwaro
entities.description: An aven veteran who is Anafenza's captain of the guard and always addresses her as 'my khan'.

entities.name: Marrit
entities.description: A captain of the Dragonscale infantry who embraces Anafenza on behalf of House Emesh.

entities.name: House Emesh
entities.description: An Abzan house that pledges kinship to Anafenza.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The desert clan of Tarkir organized into houses bound by blood and by oaths.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The warrior clan of Gvar's birth, defeated by the Abzan in the battle that orphaned him.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan whose undead-backed war party ambushes the Abzan caravan fortress.

entities.name: Anafenza's house
entities.description: A prosperous Abzan merchant house that travels in a colossal rolling fortress and is destroyed in the ambush.

entities.name: Dragonscale infantry
entities.description: The clan's elite infantry.

entities.name: The First Tree
entities.description: The tree growing from the rooftop plaza of Mer-Ek Fortress, beneath which the khans are buried, in whose plaza the Amber Throne stands.

entities.name: Mer-Ek Fortress
entities.description: The Abzan capital fortress whose keep holds the First Tree and the Amber Throne.

entities.name: Amber Throne
entities.description: The khan's seat, a solid piece of carved amber on a dais around the First Tree.

entities.name: Khan-Blade
entities.description: The khan's sword, kept on the arm of the Amber Throne.

entities.name: Salt Road
entities.description: The trade road that disappears into the Shifting Wastes from the capital.

entities.name: Shifting Wastes
entities.description: The shifting desert where caravan fortresses travel and where the ambush occurs.

entities.name: Kavah
entities.description: A city on the Salt Road where the caravan had just stopped.

entities.name: Kin-tree
entities.description: Trees in Abzan houses where ancestors' spirits dwell and names are etched; Anafenza's family's tree splits during the ambush.

events.summary: Anafenza, newly khan for two weeks, climbs the First Tree barefoot and prepares to face the heads of the houses and one hated family member.
events.quote: Anafenza always climbed barefoot.

events.summary: The heads of the clan houses gather to swear kinship, and Anafenza receives them at the Amber Throne.
events.quote: The houses had elected Anafenza to be khan

events.summary: The last delegate, her cousin Oret, recognizes Anafenza and is seized with fear.
events.quote: Recognition. Then fear.

events.summary: At her command, an orc forces Oret to his knees, and Anafenza draws the Khan-Blade.
events.quote: Anafenza ascended the dais to her throne, and slowly drew her sword, the Khan-Blade, from its scabbard.

events.summary: In a flashback, thirteen-year-old Anafenza lives aboard her house's rolling fortress on the Salt Road.
events.quote: At thirteen, she had spent most of her life rumbling from city to city throughout the Abzan lands

events.summary: Anafenza is introduced to her cousin Oret and to Gvar Barzeel, a krumar orc raised by her uncle after the battle that killed his Mardu parents and her cousin.
events.quote: Gvar was a krumar, which meant he was not born in the Abzan.

events.summary: Oret insists the caravan continue to the capital rather than return to Kavah, citing dust storms.
events.quote: I must insist we continue to the capital.

events.summary: Anafenza lashes out at Gvar, insisting they are not family, and he replies that neither chose their family.
events.quote: We're not cousins, Gvar! We're not even family!

events.summary: Hakrez, the kin-tree warden, teaches Anafenza that the kin-tree belongs to blood-kin and bond-kin alike.
events.quote: This tree belongs to all of them.

events.summary: Undead mastodons rise from the sand and a Sultai war party ambushes the caravan fortress.
events.quote: A Sultai war party!" Anafenza saw dozens of archers take positions at the parapet.

events.summary: Ancestral spirits fight an undead mastodon, but the others crash into the fortress and Anafenza is thrown from the kin-tree as it splits.
events.quote: Anafenza couldn't focus, everything went sideways, and the Salt Road rushed up to toward her.

events.summary: Anafenza finds the kin-tree shattered and the warden Hakrez dead.
events.quote: Anafenza recognized the lifeless body of Hakrez, the kin-tree warden, whose breastplate was caved in.

events.summary: As the Sultai retreat, Anafenza discovers Abzan soldiers slaughtering their own kin at the fallen fortress.
events.quote: She saw Abzan butchering Abzan.

events.summary: Gvar tells Anafenza her parents are dead and is hit by an arrow as they flee into the wastes.
events.quote: Your parents are dead. As is my bond-father.

events.summary: Anafenza and Gvar share grapes during their march, and Gvar says the clan will demand justice for the betrayal.
events.quote: Our house was betrayed, but our clan will demand justice.

events.summary: Alone at a dead village tree, Anafenza weeps for her family.
events.quote: All she could see was her kin-tree, splintered and dead.

events.summary: Anafenza ambushes two traitorous Abzan pursuers, killing one with her sword.
events.quote: One of the men turned in time to receive the point of Anafenza's blade below his breastplate.

events.summary: Interrogated, the captured attacker names Oret as the member of her house who hired the Sultai.
events.quote: Oret. It was Oret.

events.summary: Back in the present, Anafenza coolly confronts Oret, who says he thought she was dead.
events.quote: You were dead.

events.summary: Anafenza scars Oret's face with the Khan-Blade, disowns him before the First Tree, declares him her enemy, and has Gvar, her brother, show him out.
events.quote: I disown you, Oret. You are no longer of my blood.

relations.note: She has been elected khan of the Abzan Houses.
relations.quote: The houses had elected Anafenza to be khan

relations.note: He is her captain of the guard.
relations.quote: Kwaro was Anafenza's captain of the guard

relations.note: Oret is her cousin, whom she disowns.
relations.quote: Her cousin, Oret, was the house's cartographer

relations.note: He arranged the ambush that killed her family; she declares him her enemy.
He hired the Sultai to ambush his own house.
relations.quote: It was a member of your house," the man managed. "He hired the Sultai.

relations.note: He saves her and later she calls him her brother.
relations.quote: Now Gvar, my brother, show him out.

relations.note: A krumar adopted into an Abzan house after birth in the Mardu.
relations.quote: I am Abzan because when I was a child, an Abzan warrior—your uncle—killed my blood-parents in battle

relations.note: She is the family's kin-tree warden.
relations.quote: Hakrez, the family's most skilled warrior, became the kin-tree warden.

relations.note: A Sultai war party ambushes the house's fortress.
relations.quote: A Sultai war party!" Anafenza saw dozens of archers take positions at the parapet.
